rules.reason: Batch D1/D3 (plan), the same removal as the rule below, on the two pages whose removed hero chrome is 13 words rather than <= 12: es drops the eyebrow 'Probador de expresiones de GitHub Actions · CI/CD' (7 words) and the badges 'Sin registro' (2) + 'Semántica exacta de GitHub' (4); pt-br drops 'Testador de Expressões do GitHub Actions · CI/CD' (7) and 'Sem cadastro' (2) + 'Semântica exata do GitHub' (4).
